jobs.occupation: Spatial Research & Data Visualization Coordinator (m/f/d) (Stadt- und Regionalplaner/in)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
GIS Analysts; Spatial Planners; Technical Presales

Stellenbeschreibung:
Spatial Research & Data Visualization Coordinator (m/f/d) 

Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  

Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  

Target Group: GIS Analysts, Spatial Planners, Technical Presales, Opportunity Card Holders, and Master's Graduates  

About Project IRIS Project IRIS is an applied research initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis and infrastructure mapping. We generate complex spatial intelligence daily. To make these abstract algorithmic frameworks tangible for stakeholders, we need experts who can visually translate data into compelling spatial stories and commercial factsheets.  

Your Focus & Responsibilities 

- Data Translation: Analyze, validate, and visually prepare spatial resilience models and algorithmically generated energy location clusters. 
- Web-GIS Mapping: Create interactive map presentations using modern Web-GIS tools (e.g., Kepler.gl, Felt, QGIS) without building custom web applications from scratch. 
- Asset Dossiers: Design and automate the generation of clear, visual PDF/HTML factsheets (One-Pagers) for external partners and project developers. 
- Cross-Functional Interface: Act as the active bridge between our geospatial data engineering backend and practical market applications. 

What We Are Looking For 

- Technical Background: Degree in Spatial Planning, Geography, Industrial Engineering, Real Estate, Geoinformatics, or equivalent practical experience.  
- Core Technical Skills: Working knowledge of GIS tools (QGIS) and modern Web-GIS platforms. A strong eye for cartographic principles and data design. 
- Mindset: High motivation to solve spatial infrastructure challenges and translate complex data into intuitive visuals. 
- Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates (Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card supported).  
- Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a strong plus.  

What We Offer 

- Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories.  
- Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: Tailored tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support.  
- Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding.  
- Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and visa applications.  
- Direct Mentorship: Close collaboration with experienced technical architects and executive leadership.  

How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail:  

jobs-ai@iris-institut.org (Subject: Application - Spatial Research & Visualization)

jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Software Engineers; Web Scrapers; OSINT Specialists

Stellenbeschreibung:
Data Mining & OSINT Automation Specialist (m/f/d) 

Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  

Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  

Target Group: Software Engineers, Web Scrapers, OSINT Specialists, Opportunity Card Holders, and Master's Graduates  

About Project IRIS Project IRIS is an applied research and technology initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, infrastructure mapping, and open-source data modeling. Because not all valuable data exists as clean spatial polygons, we build systems that extract hidden knowledge from texts, complex web registries, and unstructured documents. In this role, you will build the autonomous agents that feed our intelligence engine.  

Your Focus & Responsibilities 

- Web Automation: Develop scalable web scrapers and autonomous agents to extract data from unstructured sources (public registers, official announcements, corporate portals). 
- Data Parsing: Parse unstructured web and document data (JSON, XML, HTML, PDF) into clean, relational database structures. 
- Entity Extraction: Apply OCR, regex, and NLP techniques to extract structured entities (addresses, capacities, corporate connections) from dense documents. 
- Pipeline Monitoring: Automate monitoring scripts to continuously feed fresh data into our central PostGIS Data Lake. 

What We Are Looking For 

- Technical Background: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, or equivalent practical industry experience.  
- Core Technical Skills: Proven experience in Web Scraping (Python, Playwright, Scrapy, Selenium, BeautifulSoup) and handling uncooperative web architectures. 
- Mindset: Analytical mindset with a drive for data cleaning, structural modeling, and robust automation. 
- Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates (Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card supported).  
- Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus.  

What We Offer 

- Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories.  
- Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: Tailored tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support.  
- Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding.  
- Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and visa applications.  
- Direct Mentorship: Close collaboration with experienced technical architects and executive leadership.

jobs-data@iris-institut.org (Subject: Application - Data Mining & Web Automation)

jobs.occupation: Geospatial Data Engineer & Spatial Pipelines (m/f/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Data Engineers; Software Engineers

Stellenbeschreibung:
Geospatial Data Engineer & Spatial Pipelines (m/f/d) 

Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  

Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  

Target Group: Software Engineers, Data Engineers, Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) Holders, and Master's Graduates  

About Project IRIS Project IRIS is an applied research and technology initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, cadastre intelligence, infrastructure mapping, and open-source data modeling. Together with our commercial transfer network, we bridge the gap between academic data science, resilience research, and practical real-world application. Complex geospatial and resilience data models are deployed into active enterprise environments and infrastructure tools. In this role, you turn algorithmic frameworks and spatial datasets into robust, production-ready digital architectures.  

Your Focus & Responsibilities 

- Geospatial Data Modeling: Develop and refine automated pipelines connecting to WFS services, REST APIs, and public open-data platforms.  
- Spatial Inference: Implement spatial overlay models for energy grid matching and land analysis directly within our PostGIS cluster. 
- Data Harmonization: Validate, clean, and transform complex vector geometries into a single coordinate reference system (EPSG:25832) before database insertion. 
- Cloud Deployment: Package services into robust Docker environments and deploy them on secure server infrastructure.  

What We Are Looking For 

- Technical Background: Degree in Geoinformatics, Computer Science, Data Science, or equivalent practical industry experience.  
- Core Technical Skills: Solid programming foundation in Python (GeoPandas, Shapely) and relational databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS).  
- Mindset: Strong analytical curiosity, proactive problem-solving attitude, and a clean-code engineering approach.  
- Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates currently in or moving to Germany (e.g., Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card).  
- Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus.  

What We Offer 

- Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories.  
- Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: Tailored tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support for candidates combining practice with academics.  
- Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding.  
- Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and German residence/work permit applications.  
- Modern Work Environment: Work in a high-efficiency tech stack focused on high-value architecture rather than boilerplate tasks.  

How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail:  

jobs-spatial@iris-institut.org (Subject: Application - Geospatial Data Engineer)

jobs.occupation: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security - ManageEngine, ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have long years of experience ( 5 + ) with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.- You have 3-5 years of experience with ManageEngine or similar technologies.
- Ways of Working: - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

Please submit your CV in English in order to be considered for the role.Tesla is accelerating the transition to sustainable energy with our industry-leading Residential Energy Products, including Powerwall, Wall Connector, Solar, and the full Residential Energy Ecosystem. As an Associate Systems Diagnostics Engineer, you’ll troubleshoot medium-to-high complexity technical issues, support internal engineering and field teams, and go deep on proprietary power electronics and energy systems. You thrive on challenging edge cases, balance detailed problem-solving with big-picture thinking, and excel in fast-paced, collaborative environments.This role is available in Amsterdam and Berlin.

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Location: Erlangen, Nürnberg, Mühlheim, Hamburg, Berlin, Lisbon, Bucharest, Warsaw

Department: SE FIN TI BC

Job Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management ÜT-Kreis

Mode of Employment: Full Time or Part Time / Permanent

A Snapshot of Your Day 

For the first 18-24 months this role has one clear focus: accompanying the carve-out of Transformation of Industry and supporting preparations for a potential future FP&A organization, hand in hand with the management team. On 25 August 2026 Siemens Energy announced preparations for the legal and operational separation of Transformation of Industry into a standalone company, a fast-growing business with around 17,000 employees, €6 billion of revenue and a double-digit profit margin.
At the moment, the central Business Controlling team of Transformation of Industry is preparing to evolve towards a potential Corporate FP&A department for a future standalone company, which could bring together more than 100 finance professionals. Its possible target organization, processes and reporting architecture are still being explored, and you will contribute to this work. You report directly to the Vice President of FP&A and work alongside the management team. The role asks you to hold two hats at once: you coordinate and organize the transformation centrally, the way a program office does, and at the same time you go deep into the content - preparing and challenging the decisions yourself and then carrying them into the organization.
A potential new team - the Center of Excellence - may grow out of this work: as the future organization develops, you help prepare a dedicated team that could bundle cross-cutting topics across the different FP&A teams, including standardized data and reporting, shared tools and systems, automation, process improvement and AI. Subject to the future setup and related decisions, the role may offer a path toward taking on team leadership responsibility for this unit.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Support the carve-out of Transformation of Industry from an FP&A perspective, including organizational and process changes, standalone company requirements, and Day 1 FP&A readiness
* Help prepare the potential future FP&A organization together with its management team, including target structures, roles and responsibilities, job profiles, and related training and reskilling needs
* Support the Vice President of FP&A in the daily business by preparing presentations, analyses, and decision-making materials for leadership and board audiences
* Improve the core FP&A processes together with the management team across planning, forecasting, closing, and reporting by turning best practices into common standards
* Take care of communication into the teams by explaining the why, keeping everyone informed, gathering input early, and making people part of the change journey
* Help develop the concept for a potential Center of Excellence within the future FP&A organization, including scope, services, operating model, staffing, roadmap, and the opportunity to potentially grow into a team leadership role

What You Bring

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Business Informatics, or a related field
* Longstanding experience in Controlling, FP&A, Finance Transformation, or Consulting, with the curiosity to grow into a carve-out environment
* An interest in organizational design, including roles, responsibilities, and interfaces, with the confidence to contribute ideas to a management team
* A solid understanding of planning, forecasting, closing, and reporting, along with strong Excel and reporting tool skills and curiosity about AI and automation
* Excellent communication and change management skills, combined with the energy, structure, and drive to build something new in an evolving environment
* Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs 

You do not need to tick every box. If this role excites you and you bring most of it, we would like to hear from you.
